title: Drawn into the Depths
introduction:
水对我而言，是一种矛盾的吸引。水面看起来平静柔和，仿佛可以承托身体。可当我想象沉入水中，视线会变得模糊，方向感消散，这份安稳也随之褪去。水下不可见之处，令我畏惧未知的危险，同时又将我不断吸引。恐惧与好奇并存，便是这件作品的起点。

我借助悬浮的半环形装置、动态影像与绘画，将被水包裹的感受转化为视觉体验。色彩从青蓝过渡到浑浊的黄，流动影像让观者如同隔着一层变幻的水进行观看。装置下方垂挂的锚，指向航行与停泊，传递出在不确定之中渴求稳定的愿望。两幅尺寸不同的画作，以层层叠叠的色彩、朦胧的形体，延续这种沉浸感。

作品探讨直面未知时的张力：既渴望抓住可靠的依托，又被无法看清的事物牵引；害怕失去掌控，却依然想要探寻更深之处。
introduction-en:
Water holds a contradictory attraction for me. Its surface appears calm and soft, as though it could support the body. Yet when I imagine entering the water, my vision blurs, my sense of direction weakens, and that reassurance begins to disappear. What I cannot see below makes me fear unknown dangers, while drawing me closer. This coexistence of fear and curiosity is the starting point of the project. 

Through a suspended, partially circular installation, moving images, and painting, I translate the sensation of being surrounded by water into a visual experience. Colours shift from cyan blue towards a murky yellow, while moving imagery makes viewing feel as though it takes place through a changing layer of water. Anchors suspended beneath the structure evoke navigation and mooring, expressing a desire for stability amid uncertainty. Two paintings of different scales extend this sense of immersion through layered colour and indistinct forms. The work explores the tension of encountering the unknown: wanting something secure to hold on to while remaining drawn towards what cannot be clearly seen; fearing a loss of control, yet still wanting to discover what lies deeper.
